name: Skadis planner
description: Plans a wall of 3D-printed IKEA Skadis boards: the fewest boards that fill it, sized to your bed, with the mounts, the print order and the plan saved as a model.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A 820 × 860 mm wall filled by 16 boards on an A1, with every mounting point marked and each part linked to the model it came from in your library.
The same wall on an A1 mini in the dark theme: fifty small boards, and the four ways they have to be mirrored so the pattern carries across every seam.
Screw spacers instead of wall mounts: four to a board, 15 mm off the wall, with the slot pattern and the spans measured.
Saving the plan as one model: a plate for every part, in print order and at its true size, with a picture of the plan as its cover and the print order in its notes.
